meaning:
Θυάτειρα, -ων, τά
(-ας, ἡ, Rev.1:11 L; cf. WH, App., 156)
Thyatira, a city of Lydia: Act.16:14, Rev.1:11 2:18, 24.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things…
saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”
